bullets.id: Emas memantul pada Senin pagi dan mengakhiri lima hari penurunan beruntun. Spot sempat naik lebih dari 2% ke atas $3.610 di awal sesi Asia, lalu diperdagangkan sekitar $3.585 (+1,42%) menurut Trading Economics. Pemicunya: aksi jual saham terkait AI mendorong permintaan aset aman, dan Menkeu AS Scott Bessent memperingatkan bahwa pengetatan agresif bisa membahayakan ekonomi.
bullets.en: Gold bounced on Monday morning, ending a five-day losing streak. Spot rose more than 2% to above $3,610 early in the Asian session, then traded around $3,585 (+1.42%), according to Trading Economics. The drivers: an AI-linked equity sell-off lifted safe-haven demand, and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned that aggressive tightening could put the economy at risk.

bullets.id: CME FedWatch kini memberi peluang sekitar 93% kenaikan 25 bps pada Desember, turun dari sekitar 99% pekan lalu. Indeks dolar turun tipis ke 103,74 dan yield 10 tahun di sekitar 4,94%. Meski memantul, emas masih turun sekitar 10,7% sebulan dan sekitar 36% di bawah rekor $5.608 pada Januari 2026.
bullets.en: CME FedWatch now puts the odds of a 25 bp December hike at about 93%, down from about 99% last week. The dollar index eased to 103.74 and the 10-year yield sits around 4.94%. Despite the bounce, gold is still down about 10.7% on the month and about 36% below its January 2026 record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Goodreturns mencatat resistance di $3.600–$3.630 lalu $3.700–$3.730, dengan support di $3.500–$3.470 lalu $3.380–$3.350. RSI harian sekitar 21–28 menandakan kondisi jenuh jual. Pasar menunggu data inflasi PCE AS; bursa AS libur Kamis 26 November untuk Thanksgiving.
bullets.en: Goodreturns lists resistance at $3,600–$3,630 then $3,700–$3,730, with support at $3,500–$3,470 then $3,380–$3,350. A daily RSI around 21–28 signals oversold conditions. Markets await the US PCE inflation report; US markets are closed Thursday, Nov. 26, for Thanksgiving.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram naik Rp10.000 ke Rp2.505.000 dan buyback naik Rp20.000 ke Rp2.115.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp390.000 (sekitar 15,6%). Galeri24 stagnan di Rp2.334.000 (buyback Rp2.195.000) dan UBS stagnan di Rp2.357.000 (buyback Rp2.171.000). Antam kini Rp171.000 lebih mahal dari Galeri24 per gram.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram bar rose Rp10,000 to Rp2,505,000 and buyback rose Rp20,000 to Rp2,115,000, narrowing the spread to Rp390,000 (about 15.6%). Galeri24 held at Rp2,334,000 (buyback Rp2,195,000) and UBS held at Rp2,357,000 (buyback Rp2,171,000). Antam is now Rp171,000 per gram dearer than Galeri24.
